# sparse_export: SYNTHETIC fixture

All values, names and identifiers in this directory are invented for tests (entity ids `SY..`, indicator ids `T..`).
It is not a measurement and not a real export. In particular it says nothing about how many (indicator, entity)
pairs a real 44-entity export holds as defined-but-empty versus undefined (plan gate G-Q4 stays open).

Hand-built shape (subset of the export files):
- 44 entities: 41 countries and 3 aggregates (`SYA1`..`SYA3`).
- `growth` (ranked): 3 entities have percentiles; `fin` (ranked) holds only the two-domain indicator `T01`; `agri` is unranked.
- `T01` is in `growth` and `fin`, with equal stored percentiles in both scorecards.
- Defined-but-empty pair: (`SY07`, `T04`) has a `meta/series.json` row and a null value. Undefined pair: (`SY08`, `T04`) has no row.
- Cells of `T02`: estimate (`SY01`), inherited (`SY02`), stale (`SY03`), lagging (`SY04`), unaligned fiscal (`SY05`), ahead (`SY06`), not published (`SY09`).
- `n_available = 0` for most countries in `growth` (for example `SY20`); `SY01`..`SY03` and `SY06` have at least one percentile.

Build completeness (so the site can be built from this directory alone, `EXPORT_DIR=tests/fixtures/sparse_export`):
- `manifest.json`, `meta/groups.json`, `alerts.json`, `revisions_recent.json` and `status.json` are SYNTHETIC too (two invented groups `synthetic_a`, `synthetic_b`; no alerts, no revisions, no series files).
- They are generated by `tests/support/make-sparse-extras.mjs` (deterministic, fixed timestamps; the manifest holds the real size and sha256 of the files here). `fixtures.test.mjs` fails if they drift from the generator.
